dimensions.assessment: Affects federal, State, Tribal, and local agencies and organizations involved with the Bay Area Ridge Trail.
dimensions.evidence: undertaken in consultation with appropriate State, Tribal, and local governmental agencies and other interested organizations

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a feasibility study and consultation process rather than creating a finalized trail designation.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a study on the feasibility of designating the Bay Area Ridge as a national scenic trail

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or funding amounts are mentioned in the text.
Amends the National Trails System Act to add a single study item.

dimensions.assessment: One-time feasibility study for a regional trail system in northern California.
dimensions.evidence: Bay Area Ridge National Scenic Trail, a multi-use trail extending approximately 550 miles... in northern California
